steps.prompt: A Data 360 Identity Resolution ruleset uses fuzzy match on Normalized Phone Number alone. Household members sharing a landline collapse into one Unified Individual, polluting consent and personalization. How should the ruleset be revised?

options.label: Require composite match criteria — e.g. phone plus exact First Name or Date of Birth — and keep reconciliation rules separate from match rules
options.rationale: Single-attribute fuzzy matching on shared identifiers causes Fuzzy Over-Clustering. Well-Architected rulesets combine high-signal attributes and treat reconciliation (field winners) as a separate stage after match groups form.

options.label: Disable Identity Resolution and unify profiles with custom Apex triggers on Contact
options.rationale: Identity Resolution is a distributed big-data graph process. Apex cannot reconcile millions of cross-source identities with the same scale, lineage, or governance.

options.label: Change only the reconciliation rule to "Most Recently Updated" and leave the phone-only match intact
options.rationale: Reconciliation chooses winning attribute values after records are already merged. It cannot undo over-merging caused by weak match criteria.
